narrative: Inventory optimization analysis for material PL1__MD0FB31E reveals a smooth demand pattern with moderate variability (CV=0.36). The material exhibits variable lead times (CV=0.48) which is the dominant source of uncertainty (81% of variance). The optimized policy recommends an EOQ-based order quantity of 80206 units with a safety stock of 13401 units to achieve 95.0% service level. This represents a significant improvement over the current SAP policy, delivering approximately $3082.36 in annual cost savings (47.9% reduction). The recommended safety lead time of 2.18 days is lower than SAP's 4.5 days, suggesting the current buffer may be conservative. The policy respects all constraints including MOQ (18898) and storage capacity (113764.66).

research_insights.selection_rationale: Smooth demand pattern with moderate variability justifies classical EOQ approach with safety stock buffer
research_insights.boundary_risk: Lead time variability is high (CV=0.48) which may require monitoring
